milestones.name: Human clips, Wire, sales, and first automation
milestones.entry: Fresh authoritative run: clips/lifetime, Unsold Inventory, and Unused Clips all 0; Funds 0; Wire 1000 with 1000-inch spools at $20; Price $0.25; Marketing level 1; Trust 2, one Processor, one Memory, and computing/projects hidden. Matter and all future-phase state use the documented initial values even before becoming visible. AutoClippers begin at count zero with reveal false and stored current cost $5, independent of the successor formula.
milestones.playable: The player first makes individual clips and sells Unsold Inventory. Before any successful Wire or initial Marketing purchase, the player observes the actual first Funds>=5 reveal and stored cost $5. The first AutoClipper costs $5, gives count 1 and next cost $6.10; a later distinct purchase at $6.10 gives count 2 and next cost $6.21. Required current-quote Wire and Price/Marketing actions follow the first reveal, which remains latched after Funds falls below $5. Production is server-generated with no clients connected. Sales reduce only Unsold Inventory; every conversion increases all three clip ledgers equally.
milestones.exit: From fresh state through the real UI, the player observes first $5 before any successful Wire/Marketing buy, purchases the first AutoClipper at exact stored cost 5/next 6.10 and a later one at 6.10/next 6.21, also sells clips, buys replacement Wire and adjusts Price/Marketing after reveal. At least one real producer continues legal Wire-limited production through refresh/reconnect and with no observer. Stored cost/count/reveal survive snapshot without backfill. Computing, Projects, and MegaClippers are not required for exit.

spec_refs.heading: PROG-START — Make Paperclip, Manufacturing, and Business

milestones.source_rationale: Primary sources: PROG-START, PROG-DEMAND-SALES, SYS-DEMAND-SALES, SYS-WIRE-MARKET, the initial RES/UI rows, and the direct Human Business controls in gameplay-actions.md and gameplay-progression.md. These systems give a real economic loop before any project exists.
milestones.technical_dependencies: The M1 platform tasks supply Rust/Axum/Tokio/Serde/SQLite runtime, one ordered writer, legal Command/View/SSE contracts, native UI, continuous independent ticks, full initial/future state schema, retry handling, and atomic 30-second-default snapshots. No public arbitrary resource write, pause, turn, or debug step API.
accepted_scenarios: Manual Make Paperclip with Wire 2 produces exactly 1 in lifetime/Unsold/Unused and leaves Wire 1; with Wire below 1 the ordinary manual command changes nothing.

The shared internal conversion passes Wire 5/request 10 => produced 5 and Wire 0; Wire 0.5/request 0.2 => produced 0 and Wire 0.5; Wire 1/request 0.2 => produced 0.2 and Wire 0.8, adding the actual amount equally to all three ledgers.
A controlled sale consumes Unsold Inventory only and credits Funds at current Price; an empty-stock opportunity adds no Funds; simultaneous purchases cannot overspend one Funds balance.
Price bottoms at $0.01 through the legal control, Marketing doubles/floors its next dollar cost, and a purchased spool yields 1000 Wire while raising base quote $0.05 and resetting inactivity.

The actual first Funds>=5 reveal and stored cost $5 are observed before every successful Wire or initial Marketing purchase, whose prices require later earnings. Replacement-Wire and Marketing purchases then occur legally and the latch survives subsequent Funds drops below $5.

Threshold purchase at Funds 5/current cost 5/count 0 charges exactly 5, leaves Funds 0/count 1/next cost 6.10; the next distinct legal purchase at current cost 6.10 charges 6.10, gives count 2/next cost 6.21. Below-price intent has no Funds/count/cost/ledger effect; duplicate ID replays the first receipt only and snapshots recover stored count/cost/reveal without offline gains or level-zero recomputation.
testing_evidence: Rule tests for initial state, conversion floor/cap, ledger identity, Wire purchase/repricing/inactivity and sales distributions using controlled RNG; property tests for nonnegative conserved resource transfers.
Command execution tests for stale-view legality, malformed/unknown actions, legal concurrent commands versus one-resource contention, and same-process retry/dedup semantics selected by the API task.
Browser E2E proves clicks submit intent rather than locally award resources, server-derived views update, refresh does not roll back, and two pages share the sole default game.
Persistence tests prove atomic full-state snapshots, last-successful recovery, no offline catch-up, complete RNG/timer/accumulator state, and continued simulation during saves.

Rule/API/native-browser first-crossing and exact current-cost tests prove $5 initial charge, $6.10 successor charge and $6.21 next quote, below-cost no-ops, duplicate-ID receipt replay, permanent reveal and exact stored snapshot state without backfill.
risks: Do not confuse an outer Wire >=1 gate with a requirement to cover the whole automatic request. Do not expose arbitrary-number free-clip production as a player command.
Stochastic sales and Wire repricing must preserve distributions/opportunities without requiring the reference RNG stream or browser timer schedule.
M1 must not become a frontend-only click demo or an infrastructure shell; the AutoClipper must be an actual continuous producer in the one authoritative game.

milestones.name: Trust-constrained self-modification and foundational Projects
milestones.entry: M1 economy works. Computing and Projects still start locked; the state can reach either 2000 lifetime clips or the independent deadlock with Unsold <1, Funds below the current Wire quote, and Wire <1.
milestones.playable: The player allocates Human Trust between Processors and Memory, generates 10 Ops/s per Processor up to Memory*1000, buys project offers, unlocks Creativity at cap, and purchases the first 18 canonical projects plus RevTracker. Beg for More Wire supplies the genuine Trust-cost recovery path.
milestones.exit: Both computing unlock routes are demonstrated; a player can buy and use Creativity, additive AutoClipper upgrades, cumulative Wire-extrusion upgrades including project10b, Trust/creativity projects, and RevTracker. Displayed offers follow their PROPOSED source-preserving latch while purchase affordability remains server-authoritative. M2 independently proves ordinary allocation/Ops/creativity/panel/snapshot continuity without requiring an offered or purchased Xavier.

spec_refs.heading: PROG-COMP-UNLOCK — Trust-Constrained Self-Modification, Computational Resources, and Projects
SYS-OPS-CREATIVITY-CURVES — Exact processor rates, Creativity curve, and Xavier recovery

milestones.source_rationale: Primary sources: gameplay-projects.md sections 3, 5.1 and canonical PRJ-001..018/039; PROG-COMP-UNLOCK/TRUST/OPS/CREATIVITY/WIRE-RECOVERY/REVTRACKER; SYS-PROJECT-OFFER-LATCH and SYS-OPS-CREATIVITY-CURVES.
milestones.technical_dependencies: Extends the M1 state, Commands and project-offer model; all offers, uses, dynamic prices, rates and accumulators must be included in consistent snapshots and derived views.
accepted_scenarios: At 2000 lifetime clips, Computing/Projects unlock without requiring deadlock. Independently, an early no-stock/no-Wire/insufficient-Funds state unlocks them before 2000; portfolio and liquid-Funds conditions for Beg for More Wire remain distinct.

Initial Processor+Memory consume the initial Trust-2 capacity. Adding either requires unspent capacity without decrementing Trust. Memory adds 1000 max Ops; Processors regenerate 10 Ops/s each and recompute the source nonlinear Creativity formula with exact special points and a documented approximation budget.
Fresh Creativity speed remains 1 although evaluating the recomputation formula at P=1 yields zero. While Ops are held at cap after project3, Creativity accrues; spending below cap pauses it.

PRJ-001/004/005 add +0.25/+0.50/+0.75 to one multiplier and PRJ-018 adds +5, never compounding those additions. PRJ-007..010 follow supply thresholds; PRJ-011 project10b uses the stochastic Wire quote and multiplies current supply by 11.

A displayed offer remains eligible after its entry trigger ceases, until consumed or explicitly cancelled, but an unaffordable purchase is rejected at execution. Repeatable PRJ-002 requires its crisis trigger for each new offer; a purchase allowed at Trust -100 leaves -101 and no further affordable bailout.
PRJ-039 RevTracker uses analytic demand estimates when stock suffices and rolling realized revenue when stock-limited; it does not itself sell clips or alter demand.

ENG-TRUST-OPS-CREATIVITY independently validates M2 allocation, exact special points and approximation-budgeted nonlinear speed arithmetic without requiring offered or purchased Xavier: fresh speed 1 versus P=1 recomputation zero, P=2 positive at approximately 1.645271921560140886 and 20 Ops/s, legal capacity, a guarded zero-speed countdown, full-cap Creativity and complete snapshots without offline gains.
testing_evidence: Per-project tests verify trigger, separate cost, exact effect, one-shot/repeat behavior, and downstream flag for every owned PRJ row; source-array position is not treated as an execution prerequisite.

Sequence tests cover offer creation/latching/re-offer/cancellation, concurrency between an offer purchase and resource ticks, additive boost stacking, Wire-supply thresholds, both computation gates, and Trust target Fibonacci-thousand progression.

UI/API tests expose Trust, next target, Processors, Memory, standard/temporary Operations, Creativity, project costs and meaningful rejection reasons without making client-disabled state authoritative.

M2-only rule/API/browser/snapshot cases test exact Trust capacity, processor/Memory additions, 10/20 Ops/s, fresh-versus-recomputed nonlinear speed, full-cap Creativity, complete compute continuation and no M3 project purchase.
risks: The offer latch is PROPOSED, not CONFIRMED. Do not replace it with a continuously re-evaluated trigger or reproduce DOM nodes as authority.
Negative Trust is meaningful for the bailout; Trust is otherwise configuration capacity, not a normal balance spent on Processor/Memory allocation.
Do not infer project dependencies from numeric suffixes: project17 precedes project16 and PRJ-018 is a side branch, not part of boostLvl.

milestones.name: Scaled Human automation, Quantum Computing, and alternate reset
milestones.entry: M1/M2 production and compute work. At least 75 AutoClippers, 15 Wire purchases, five Processors, and sufficient Ops can be reached through real play. Existing persistent U/S may be absent on a first run.
milestones.playable: The player buys MegaClippers and their additive upgrades, toggles affordable WireBuyer, activates ten Photonic Chips sequentially, times signed quantum Compute, uses damped positive overflow, can repeatedly respec Processor/Memory through Xavier, and can choose Quantum Temporal Reversion after sufficiently negative Operations.
milestones.exit: MegaClipper production and full WireBuyer automation function through the shared conversion and dynamic Wire market. Ten chips produce inspectable waves; Xavier restores allocation capacity without resetting the run; Temporal Reversion clears ordinary state without granting U/S and retains existing U/S.

spec_refs.heading: 1.3 Computation, Quantum Computing, and Swarm recovery
PROG-QUANTUM — Quantum Computing and Photonic Chips

milestones.technical_dependencies: Adds deterministic wave clocks, portfolio-independent machine state, repeat uses/dynamic prices and full reset orchestration to the complete snapshot and derived view.
accepted_scenarios: PRJ-023 unlocks MegaClippers only at 75 AutoClippers; PRJ-024/025/026 add +0.25/+0.50/+1 to the separate Mega multiplier. Release is not yet allowed to clear these levels.
WireBuyer is offered after 15 purchases, starts internally ON, toggles without price, invokes the ordinary affordable purchase only at Wire <=1 in Human play, and never discounts or bypasses Funds.

Quantum Computing requires five Processors before PRJ-046. Compute without an active chip says Need Photonic Chips. PRJ-047 buys exactly ten chips at 10000 then +5000 Ops each, with deterministic signed sinusoidal values rather than loot RNG.

Overflow uses raw Q=ceil(360*sum), free capacity B and D=tempOps/100+5; if Q>B the actual immediate positive credit is based on ceil(Q/D), while feedback still reports raw Q. Negative qOps can expose PRJ-094 at Operations <=-10000.

Each Human-stage PRJ-096 purchase costs 100000 Creativity and sets Processors/Memory/speed to zero, leaving Trust available and other ordinary run/prestige state intact. The first re-added Processor still has zero speed; the P=2 curve evaluates to a positive value within its documented approximation budget. A second sufficiently funded distinct purchase charges another 100000 Creativity without a full-run/prestige reset.
Confirming PRJ-094 adds 10000 standard Ops before full current-run reset, grants no prestige, clears project/strategy state, and retains separately stored U/S. Cancelling does not consume the offer.
testing_evidence: Rule/sequence tests cover baseline and boosted Mega rates, all boost combinations, WireBuyer at empty/low Funds and ON/OFF, ten-chip limit/cost, signed sums, overflow fade/merge, negative trigger, the source nonlinear curve and its approximation budget, two real 100000-Creativity Xavier purchases and first/second-Processor recovery.

Reset/persistence tests distinguish full run reset from last-snapshot crash recovery and prove no ordinary project, strategy, timer, or resource carryover after Temporal Reversion, while existing U/S survive unchanged.
No arbitrary negative Compute input or debug reset is exposed. Controlled engine time/RNG is used for tests, never a public clock or resource-write API.
risks: Do not credit unrestricted raw qOps or make chip values random. Do not turn Xavier into a prestige reset or Temporal Reversion into an ending.
PRJ-095 page-refresh use repair is a browser defect and is not implemented here or later. PRJ-094 confirmation UI may be native server-supported flow but not a commented cheat control.

milestones.name: Investments, Yomi, and the complete strategy pool
milestones.entry: Human economy, compute, Creativity and automation work. Trust 8 can unlock Algorithmic Trading; Donkey Space can unlock Strategic Modeling; no investor or tournament behavior is yet required.
milestones.playable: The player deposits/withdraws Cash, selects risk, lets a stochastic portfolio trade automatically, upgrades its engine with Yomi, and runs full automatic tournaments with a selected strategy. The seven new strategies, Theory of Mind, CEV/humanitarian Trust routes, takeover/monopoly demand routes and closing Limerick become playable.

All N*N ordered tournament pairings, including self-play, generate valid-selection Yomi; the full eight-strategy pool and Theory of Mind work. Default no-selection behavior is demonstrated without reward or completed-result state.

spec_refs.heading: PROG-YOMI — Strategic Modeling, tournaments, and AutoTourney

milestones.source_rationale: Primary sources: PROG-INVESTMENTS/YOMI/TRUST-PROJECTS; SYS-INVESTMENT-AUTO/TOURNEY-*; direct investment/tournament controls; PRJ-020..022/031..035/037/038/048..054/062/095.
milestones.technical_dependencies: Adds snapshot-complete portfolio/RNG/tournament state to the same ordered simulation; no separate tournament turn or actor model. The no-selection and hover UI are derived from authoritative results.
accepted_scenarios: Deposit transfers all ordinary Funds to integer investment Cash and Withdraw returns only Cash, never Stocks. Low/Med/High risk maps to 7/5/1 and changes reserves/budget and price step, not deposit timing.

Controlled RNG verifies the 1 Hz 25% buy checks, five-holding cap, source price-band probabilities, 2.5-second move/sell opportunities and integer shares. PRJ-037 visibility uses portTotal>=10000 while its $1 million cost uses liquid Funds; PRJ-038 then costs $10 million Funds+3000 Yomi and multiplies distinct demand boosts.

PRJ-020/021 expose Strategic Modeling. A new tournament charges current Ops and generates a symmetric integer 1..10 payoff grid. Every ordered pairing including h==v plays ten moves, and self-play credits both seats to the same strategy.

The initial RANDOM-only self-play earns actual selected-score Yomi. Each PRJ-048..054 adds one real strategy and +1000 tournament Ops cost; PRJ-062 requires eight strategies, fixes cost 16000 and doubles score-derived Yomi only.

Leaving Pick a Strat selected still spends 1000 baseline Ops and runs all matches, but awards no Yomi, creates no ordinary result state and does not establish the result flag needed by later AutoTourney. Clear feedback is PROPOSED; retroactive rewards/results are forbidden. Selecting a real strategy on a later run restores normal completion.

PRJ-031..035 pay their exact Creativity/Yomi/Ops costs and grant their distinct Trust/stock modifiers as independent CEV siblings; PRJ-095 costs 1 million Creativity, grants no Trust, and is one-shot during uninterrupted play.
testing_evidence: Controlled-RNG distribution tests prove portfolio opportunities and tournament grids/RANDOM moves without matching reference random sequences; deterministic strategy fixtures distinguish each strategy rule.

Sequence tests cover valid reward/placement, ties, both-seat self-play, Theory-of-Mind score boost versus later flat bonuses, no-selection cost/no result/no reward, hover information and delay reset, and Human-to-autonomy shutdown of investing in M5.

Server-time tests prove tournaments/investments do not become Human/Agent turns and no browser/Agent wait pauses the shared simulation. Economy scenarios reach takeover and Trust routes without an operator resource-write API.
risks: No-selection display clarification remains PROPOSED; the cost, match execution, no reward and result-flag interruption are required source consequences.
Do not turn portfolio Total into withdrawable Cash or into the Takeover purchase currency. Do not remove self-play, which would break early Yomi.
PRJ-032..035 are siblings, not a chain. PRJ-061 AutoTourney is deliberately M5 because Trust 90 belongs to late-Human play.

spec_refs.heading: PROG-HYPNO-RELEASE — Catchy Jingle to Release the HypnoDrones
5.2 Autonomy, terrestrial production, power, and space

milestones.source_rationale: Primary sources: PROG-TRUST-PROJECTS/HYPNO-RELEASE, SYS-TOURNEY-NO-SELECTION, PRJ-019/028/029/030/043/044/061, and the Human-to-autonomy handoff in gameplay-actions.md.
milestones.technical_dependencies: Requires cancellation of active offers, subsystem enable/disable transitions and full snapshot state. Tóth is sequenced inside this milestone after Release; The mapped platform capabilities do not require an extra milestone.
accepted_scenarios: PRJ-061 requires Strategic Modeling and Trust>=90, costs 50000 Creativity, and toggles ON/OFF without another fee. Sufficient Ops plus a completed viewed valid result schedule New+Run; payoff-grid hover resets the viewing delay.

A no-selection tournament from M4 awards nothing and leaves no result flag, so it interrupts AutoTourney even while ON. A later manual valid-selection tournament can restore continuation. Inactive browsers and reasoning Agents never create a pause or turn boundary.

PRJ-043 requires Human, 85<=Trust<100 and lifetime clips>=101000000, costs $500000 and grants +1. PRJ-044 starts at $1 million, doubles after each +1 Trust purchase, and stops new offers at Trust 100.

Release requires PRJ-029 and at least the 100-Trust price. At Trust 101 it still sets Trust to 0, not 1. Auto/Mega levels become 0 while lifetime/Unused capital, Ops capacity, Creativity, Yomi and purchased upgrades persist.
Release removes any active PRJ-044 and PRJ-096 offers and ends production-Trust, sales/demand, investment and WireBuyer processing. Manual Make Paperclip remains outside the removed containers.
Post-release PRJ-019 requires PRJ-017 and Human flag off, costs 45000 Ops, and exposes the path to Power Grid; it is not purchasable during Human play.
testing_evidence: Route tests demonstrate multiple legitimate Trust-100 combinations rather than requiring every project. Dynamic goodwill cost, one-shot/repeat limits and release cancellation are exercised with state-contending commands.

Stage tests compare complete pre/post-release ledgers and panels; long-running sales/investment/Trust/legacy-clipper loops must stop while compute/projects/manual conversion and appropriate tournaments continue.
AutoTourney tests include valid results, insufficient Ops, OFF state, no-selection interruption and recovery; no test fakes a pause, Agent turn or free tournament.
risks: The hard chain is PRJ-015 -> PRJ-013 -> PRJ-028 -> PRJ-029 -> PRJ-030; New Slogan is not a formal prerequisite. Tóth follows Release through an independent post-Human trigger.
Do not merely subtract 100 Trust, preserve legacy clippers, or reset all prior progress. Release is the canonical autonomy handoff, not the commented HypnoDrone debug overlay.
Only the next Milestone M2 needs coarse work packages for initial integration; M5 remains roadmap detail, not a stale Issue backlog.

milestones.name: Autonomous matter, Wire, factories, and continuous Power
milestones.entry: Tóth is complete after Release. Human Trust and legacy clippers are gone; Unused Clips, computing and strategic currencies remain. Available Matter is 6e27 unless already consumed, Acquired Matter 0, and Earth Power initially 0.
milestones.playable: The player buys Power Grid, Nanoscale Wire Production, both drone technologies and Clip Factories; then constructs Solar Farms, Battery Towers, Harvesters, Wire Drones and Factories with Unused Clips. Harvesters move Available -> Acquired, Wire Drones make Wire, Factories make clips through the shared three-ledger conversion.

spec_refs.heading: PROG-MATTER-PIPELINE — Available Matter to Acquired Matter to Wire to Paperclips
PROG-POWER — Power Grid, Solar Farms, Battery Towers, and Momentum
SYS-POWER-PARTIAL-BROWNOUT — Official brownout evidence and confirmed continuous-supply behavior

milestones.source_rationale: Primary sources: PROG-TOTH-INDUSTRY/MATTER-PIPELINE/POWER; SYS-CLIP-PRODUCTION/POWER/POWER-PARTIAL-BROWNOUT; PRJ-036/040/041/042/067 and terrestrial construction/UI/resource rows.
milestones.technical_dependencies: Adds coupled deterministic accumulators and facility bills to ordered ticks/snapshots. Numeric time bases must keep S, D and B consistent; this is an engineering choice, not new game balance.
accepted_scenarios: The actual project spine is PRJ-019 (M5) -> PRJ-067 Power Grid -> PRJ-036 Nanoscale -> PRJ-040 and PRJ-041 drones -> PRJ-042 Clip Factories. Stage flags, not the ordered achievement-message number, gate these offers.

Batch construction buys exactly the requested 1/10/100/1000 units and requires the full computed escalating batch cost. Actual spends are tracked for later refunds; factories use the banded next-cost curve from ACT-FACTORY-BUILD.

Harvester and Wire Drone output is capped by Available/Acquired Matter respectively and scales with asset count, Power and shared Work/Think. Factory output is capped by Wire and adds actual production equally to lifetime/Unsold/Unused.

For S<D and B>=D-S, storage covers the deficit at base factor 1. For 0<B<D-S, the last partial-cover update consumes B and uses (S+B)/D. With empty storage it uses S/D. Tests reject both the old (2S+B-D)/D formula and a clamp of it.

Surplus charges only up to 10000 MW-seconds per Battery Tower; farm generation and factory/drone consumption use documented normalized rates. Power UI shows generation, consumption, storage/max and Factory/Drone Performance.
testing_evidence: Deterministic power boundary tests cover exact cover, just-insufficient storage, the final partially covered update, exhaustion, zero supply/demand safeguards required by the existing rules, storage cap, and downstream matter/Wire/clip changes.

Matter-chain conservation and cap tests exercise insufficient input at every link and fractional automatic production. Simultaneous builds/ticks cannot double-spend Unused Clips or produce from nonexistent stock.
Gameplay scenarios traverse Release/Tóth to a powered matter-to-clip chain through the real UI; API/SSE/persistence tests include Power, construction bills and all accumulators.
risks: This milestone intentionally owns the CONFIRMED Power deviation but no other behavior changes. Do not reuse the source partial-battery discontinuity.
Human dollar costs are not reused for autonomous facilities. Full-batch affordability is authoritative even if a direct source function could partially execute.

PROG/SYS shared conversion was implemented at M1 but completes its cross-stage acceptance here; later Space construction reuses the same legal internal operation, not a public arbitrary amount command.

milestones.name: Capital recovery, Momentum, and quadratic industrial upgrades
milestones.entry: Basic powered Earth industry works and can accumulate enough drones/factories/farms to trigger the industrial projects. Facility spend bills record actual manual purchase outlays.
milestones.playable: The player can Disassemble All each facility class for tracked-spend refunds and buy 10/20/50-factory, 500/5000/50000-drone and 30-farm projects. Late upgrades introduce the actual asset-level factors rather than flat-only bonuses.
milestones.exit: Refund/rebuild decisions work without erasing lifetime production, persistent maximum asset milestones or purchased upgrades. Momentum grows under fully supplied conditions; upgraded factories and each drone type exhibit the documented quadratic scaling.

spec_refs.heading: PROG-CAPEX-REFUNDS — Facility construction and Disassemble All refunds

milestones.technical_dependencies: Adds persistent maximum levels and exact immutable spend-ledger handling to snapshots. Facility reboot routines will later be reused by Space transition without charging player commands.
accepted_scenarios: Factory Disassemble All returns factoryBill, resets level/bill/cost and preserves maxFactoryLevel; Harvester/Wire Drone equivalents preserve maximum-drone milestones and cause actual Swarm-size/composition effects once M8 exists.

Farm disassembly refunds farmBill but does not itself erase stored Power; Battery disassembly refunds batteryBill and discards stored Power. All refunds increase Unused Clips only and never reduce lifetime clips.

PRJ-055/056 multiply factory base rate by 100 and 1000 independently at 10/20 factories; PRJ-057 costs 1e21 Unused at 50 and adds the current factory-level factor, producing quadratic full output before Wire/Power caps.

PRJ-058/059 multiply both drone base rates by 100/1000 independently at 500/5000 total drones. PRJ-060 costs 50000 Yomi at 50000 and sets droneBoost=2, adding each type’s own level factor, not exponential growth.

PRJ-065 becomes available at 30 farms and costs 20000 Creativity. While fully supplied, including battery-covered deficits, Momentum adds the normalized +0.05/s modifier; insufficient supply recomputes from the confirmed brownout rules.
testing_evidence: Cost/refund tables verify every factory price band and exact partial historical bills built from mixed single/batch purchases. Disassembly tests distinguish farm-versus-battery storage and current versus maximum asset counts.
Numeric production tests compare unupgraded, independently stacked and quadratic upgrade states at fixed Power/Work/input stock, then verify caps after multipliers.

Recovery and disassembly-reentry tests ensure rebuilt facilities, active offers and old upgrades interact correctly after snapshot recovery without treating browser localStorage behavior as authority.
risks: Probe-built infrastructure later uses fixed costs and does not enter these manual bills. Do not erase upgrades on Disassemble All or confuse reset-cost with reset-max-level.
This is not an alternate free resources or developer reset path; every refund is limited to recorded actual spend.

milestones.name: Swarm Work/Think, Gifts, Boredom, and Disorganization
milestones.entry: At least 200 combined Harvester/Wire Drones can be operating on autonomous Earth. Human Trust is gone; Yomi, Creativity and post-Human compute remain. Swarm health accumulation conceptually runs after Release even before the panel unlock.

spec_refs.heading: PROG-SWARM-GIFTS — Swarm Computing, Work/Think, and computational gifts
PROG-SWARM-HEALTH — Boredom, Disorganization, and swarm recovery
SYS-SWARM-HEALTH-GATES — Hidden health accumulation, status precedence, and power gates

milestones.source_rationale: Primary sources: PROG-SWARM-GIFTS/HEALTH, SYS-SWARM-SIM/HEALTH-GATES, PRJ-066, CTL-SWARM-WORK-THINK and the two recovery actions/UI.
milestones.technical_dependencies: Adds gift bits, health counters/latches, slider and Gift-funded allocation to snapshots and real-time processing; no client attention or browser tab activity is a prerequisite.
accepted_scenarios: PRJ-066 costs 36000 Yomi at 200 combined drones. Slider 0 gives drone work*2 and no Think; 200 stops those two drone processes and maximizes Think; intermediate values use (200-position)/100 and position/100.

Active bit generation is ln(droneCount)*Think. At 125000 bits, gift size is max(1,round(log10(droneCount)*Think)), then giftBits=0. No excess carries into the next period, and no powMod multiplier scales gift generation.

Only Active generates Gifts: Swarm must be enabled, powMod nonzero, at least two drones, no Bored/Disorganized override and, after later Space entry, Reboot. Sleeping, Lonely, zero-drone and NO RESPONSE never generate through the Active path.

Boredom arises from sustained drone activity with zero Available Matter (source 30000 main updates/about 300 seconds nominal) and Entertain spends the current Creativity cost starting 10000, increasing by 10000. Restoring matter reduces counter but does not clear a latched Bored state.

An effective drone-type ratio above 1.5 accumulates Disorganization to 100, balancing recovers slowly, and Synchronize spends 5000 Yomi to clear the state. Health can latch before project126 and becomes visible immediately on unlock.
Feed/Teach/Clad stay non-implementation exclusions: their functions/statuses are not defined or assigned in the reviewed capture. They must not become invented Power/Ops/recovery actions.
testing_evidence: Gift arithmetic tests use documented exact points and approximation budgets to distinguish ln bit accumulation from log10 gift size, Active-only gating, the 125000 threshold, minimum/half-up award and zero reset; zero-rate views do not reset valid state. Zero/one/two-drone and partial/full-zero Power cases are separated.
State-sequence tests cover pre-unlock health accumulation, Bored/Disorganized latching and precedence, Work/Think production extremes, and current-cost recovery commands under concurrent ticks.
Three exclusion review records are linked to UI-SWARM acceptance; E2E shows only functional Bored/Disorganized recovery and non-functional legacy controls are not advertised as gameplay.
risks: Health status does not add an undocumented industrial penalty beyond Power and Work/Think. Partial nonzero Power does not sleep or scale Gifts.
The commented old gift accumulator and undefined Feed/Teach/Clad affordances are not alternative mechanics. Space NO RESPONSE/Reboot is exercised after M9/M10.

milestones.name: Earth exhaustion and the Space Exploration handoff
milestones.entry: Autonomous Earth has working industry, Power, refunds, upgrades and Swarm. Available Matter can reach exactly zero through the real matter chain; the player can accumulate the large Space costs.
milestones.playable: The player decides when to buy Space Exploration after Available Matter reaches zero. The transition converts the established Earth economy into space-capable production and exposes Launch Probe and Probe Design surfaces for the next increment.
milestones.exit: Space is active after paying 120000 Ops, 10000000 stored MW-seconds and 5e27 Unused Clips. acceptance_criteria.statement: From the exact M1 entry state, a real browser user using only legal public controls and real online ticks can reach every gameplay-map-defined M1 exit condition; the evidence names the concrete final state rather than a smoke startup.

All M1 features owned by the integrated coverage map have their actual engine behavior, typed command/config path, public feedback, UI surface where required, snapshot state, test evidence, and exactly one milestone owner.

Automatic M1 behavior advances with zero browsers/SSE/Agents; two pages plus an Agent can concurrently act and observe; resource contention, retry, rejection, and stale-view behavior remain correct end to end.
Snapshot/recovery restores every M1 continuation field without offline backfill, and old clients resynchronize without pre-crash state overwriting the recovered run.

The final M1 CI/main evidence contains actual rule, sequence, concurrency, API, SSE, persistence, real-browser, and scenario commands/results appropriate to each risk; no selected M1 control remains a placeholder.

required_tests.method: M1 playable acceptance scenario: Execute the precise integrated scenario from a fresh legitimate server through the real browser while recording Commands, Views, ticks, and final authoritative state; include a separate structured Agent observer/controller.

Zero-client and shared-world integration: Let automatic M1 systems run with no clients, then attach two pages and an Agent to issue legal, retry, conflicting, and contested Commands under online ticks.
M1 recovery/reconnect scenario: Create a normal snapshot during the playable state, make further progress, simulate crash/restart/reconnect, and advance wall time before resuming.

Feature/coverage closure: Run the integrated execution-plan validator plus feature-specific tests and sample every M1 canonical ID to its implemented engine/API/UI/snapshot/test evidence as applicable.

Negative anti-demo controls: Attempt forged resource totals, arbitrary conversion amounts, unknown controls, public pause/step, and an unimplemented future command; inspect browser networking and CI artifacts.

evidence_requirements: M1 playable acceptance scenario: Every specified exit condition is reached through legal public operations with no debug intervention, and the log proves both manual and automatic behavior required by M1.
Zero-client and shared-world integration: Off-client progress occurs and all clients converge to the same serial authoritative state with no lost update or double execution.
M1 recovery/reconnect scenario: The restored state contains all M1 progress through the last commit only, has no offline gains, and is accepted over stale pre-crash Views.
Feature/coverage closure: No M1 feature lacks an implementation and acceptance path, no alias/exclusion becomes an extra feature, and all dependency Issues are closed only after main verification.
Negative anti-demo controls: Nothing unauthorized mutates state, no future stub reports success, and the evidence demonstrates gameplay rather than only server/page startup.
